title: Swim Meet Result Finish Time Leaderboard
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swim:meet finish_time_seconds=*
| stats sum(finish_time_seconds) as total_value, avg(finish_time_seconds) as avg_value by event_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks event values by total and average finish time across swim meet result events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `finish_time_seconds` values for each swim meet result event and review total and average finish time by event.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total finish time.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which event shows the biggest finish time numbers in your swim meet result data.
